FOR IN-PERSON ADVANCE VOTING ONLY

Advance Voting Flyer

 

For more information, including the Vote by Mail Application, please visit

www.cobbcounty.gov/Elections or call (770) 528-2581

On Election Day, November 3, 2026, voters must go to their assigned polling location, open 7am-7pm

 

 

Advance Voting Statistics

General Information

  • Advance Voting generally begins 21 days prior to Election Day, or as soon as possible for runoffs
  • To vote in person you must show one of six types of Photo ID
  • Ballots cannot be removed from the voting room
